creative_brief.emotional_promise: Everyone steers the same currents: your quiet choice can carry the whole table into an unexpected encounter.
creative_brief.format_rationale: The two-current game needs a visual inventory, full setup, four resolution steps, a worked round and recovery guidance. Six compact pages keep each teaching task together while fitting alongside the 210 mm board. No bleed; 14 mm safe margins.
creative_brief.physical_format: Six-page portrait booklet, 190 x 240 mm, single pages in reading order; corner-staple or keep as three duplex leaves.
teaching_arc: Meet the currents and identify the kit
Choose secretly and turn every passenger
Share rewards, then cross and drift
typography: Body and diagram labels: embedded Bitstream Vera
creative_brief.visual_motif: Concentric harbor circles, numbered action badges and paired before/after boards echo the shared-current mechanism. Exact product imagery anchors the cover and crossing lesson.

findings: Page 1 lists kit quantities in prose but stacked boats cannot establish the count, and paper accessories lack a visual inventory.
Page 4 crops boats in the crossing images and lacks explicit state labels and a movement cue.
Page 4 sharing-table boat counts could be read as all boats rather than selected boats.
resolved_changes: Added a countable inventory of ten A/B boats in five numbered pairs, five card faces labeled as five sets, a score sheet and an owner-supplied pencil; labeled the three board parts.

Enlarged the crossing image window to show all boats, labeled scoring and selected-boat lifting states, and added a dashed inner-1-to-outer-2 crossing arrow on the complete worked example with a page reference.
Qualified the sharing table as selected boats at the harbor across both rings.
Split the full-resolution crossing image into two lossless PDF image tiles to satisfy the per-stream decoded-size limit; the page geometry and source pixels are preserved.
